question: 'Maila Aanchal’, one of the finest examples of regional novels is written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phanishwar Nath Renu**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Phanishwar Nath Renu:**

 
 
• Phanishwar Nath Renu was a prominent Hindi writer known for his regional novels.
 
• "Maila Aanchal" (The Soiled Border) is considered his most significant work and a landmark in Hindi literature.
 
• The novel portrays the social, political, and cultural life of a village in the Purnia district of Bihar.
 
• Renu's writing is characterized by its realistic depiction of rural life and its use of local dialects.
 
• He is considered one of the most important writers of the post-independence Hindi literature period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Kamleshwar:**

 
 
• Kamleshwar was a renowned Hindi writer, playwright, and screenwriter.
 
• He was known for his progressive and socially relevant writings.
 
• He contributed significantly to the "Nayi Kahani" (New Story) movement in Hindi literature.
 
• He also served as the editor of several literary magazines.
 
• His work often dealt with the changing social and political landscapes of India.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Kedar Nath Singh:**

 
 
• Kedar Nath Singh was a prominent Hindi poet and critic.
 
• He was known for his modern and experimental poetry.
 
• His poems often explored themes of nature, human relationships, and social issues.
 
• He received the Jnanpith Award, one of India's highest literary honors.
 
• His poetry is known for its simple language and deep emotional impact.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Munshi Premchand:**

 
 
• Munshi Premchand was a legendary Hindi and Urdu writer known for his realistic portrayals of Indian society.
 
• His works often focused on the lives of peasants, the poor, and the marginalized.
 
• He is considered one of the pioneers of modern Hindi literature.
 
• His notable works include "Godaan," "Gaban," and "Idgah."
 
• He wrote many short stories, and novels that have been translated into many languages.
